 staff carry the suitable safety ID category,

Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the 
 work area is required,

Personal protective equipment must be used as 
 safety shoes, and safety Helmet...etc.
Line isolation is required.

Make sure CT secondary 
 circuits are shorted before isolating the relay current circuits for test 
 current injection.

Switch off DC power 
 supply before changing setting of the relay.

Secondary 
 injection test set,

Clamp ammeter, 
 voltmeter, test leads,
Complete tool set
Disconnect the circuit breaker for feeder
Remove the input current terminal number (8 &11) from terminal board ( A )
Connect test leads between the current terminal (8&11)

Increase the injected current slowly until the red indication on the 
 instantaneous current (Earth) relay appears
Record this value on the test sheet ( adjust it if needed )
Put the circuit breaker on the test position,
Request the operator to switch on the circuit breaker,
Injecting the pick-up current into the relay,
Check that the circuit breaker tripped
Disconnect the test leads from the terminals board (A),
Connect the input current terminal (8&11) in terminals board (A),
Disconnect the test leads from timer terminal on the relay,

If any equipment associated with the relay has been isolated, it should be 
 returned to service by the following restoration steps
Breaker trip coil,
Breaker failure scheme associated this relay,
Disturbance alarm and fault recorder associated with this relay

Protection | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document out lines 
 the testing procedure I1, which must be performed every six months as 
 indicated by M6 in the title block.
This procedure details the steps required to 
 completely check the proper operation and testing of the relay
The document is formatted the way to minimize the 
 possibility of error causing personal injury or damage to equipment.
The first draft 
 initiated by eng. Wael Taha Yousef, tested by eng. Mohamed Osman, revised by EDEPC 
 quality control eng. Adel Abd El_Kader El_Naggar, and accepted by general director 
 eng. Sawsan Mohamed El_Lethy.
This document accepted by eng. Samir Abd El Gilil: 
 EDEPC inspection & quality control general director, MPIS coordinator, 
 approved and certified by accountant Mahmoud Soliman EDEPC admin & financial 
 inspection & quality control's general director and supervisor of inspection & 
 quality control head sector
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued, qualified maintenance 
 staff carry the suitable safety ID category,
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the 
 work area is required,
Personal protective equipment must be used as 
 safety shoes, and safety Helmet...etc.

Line isolation is required.
Make sure CT secondary 
 circuits are shorted before isolating the relay current circuits for test 
 current injection.
Switch off DC power 
 supply before changing setting of the relay.
Tools and 
Equipment
Secondary 
 injection test set,
Clamp ammeter, 
 voltmeter, test leads,
Complete tool set
Work to be Carried out
Earth Fault Relay Test
Disconnect the circuit breaker for feeder
Remove the input current terminal number (8 &11) from terminal board ( A )
Connect test leads between the current terminal (8&11)
Increase the injected current slowly until the red indication on the 
 instantaneous current (Earth) relay appears
Record this value on the test sheet ( adjust it if needed )
Trip Test
Put the circuit breaker on the test position,
Request the operator to switch on the circuit breaker,
Injecting the pick-up current into the relay,
Check that the circuit breaker tripped
Return Relay to Service
Disconnect the test leads from the terminals board (A),
Connect the input current terminal (8&11) in terminals board (A),
Disconnect the test leads from timer terminal on the relay,
If any equipment associated with the relay has been isolated, it should be 
 returned to service by the following restoration steps
Breaker trip coil,
Breaker failure scheme associated this relay,
Disturbance alarm and fault recorder associated with this relay
